notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating nine 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.
